title: Zesty Peruvian Chicken Roast
description: Sour, spicy, and chewy Peruvian-style roast chicken with a zesty lime-chili glaze, perfect for midnight cravings and nut‑free diners.
instructions: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, vinegar, chili flakes, cumin, coriander, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken, including inside the cavity.
Place the onion quarters in the cavity and tie the legs with kitchen twine.
Place the chicken breast‑side up on a rack in a roasting pan.
Roast for 20 minutes, then baste with pan juices and sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top.
Continue roasting, basting every 20 minutes, for a total of 80 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving. Serve hot, optionally with a wedge of lime and extra cilantro.
